body:
A custom Superflat-type Overworld that has all the biomes and most of the features and structures you’d find in a normal 1.20-1.20.1 world. Created as a custom worldgen option for my new long-term stream series on YouTube.

Inspired by [FlatBiomes by RyukenLouiga](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/flatbiomes/) on PlanetMinecraft and the Skyflat superflat preset I used in my regular stream series.

Desert Pyramids, Jungle Temples, and Woodland Mansions don’t generate in the current version, but may be fixed in a later update.
As far as features go, the main things missing are lava and water pools, vegetation, Desert Wells and Buried Treasure Chests. Trees don’t generate outside villages either, so Cocoa Beans and the Heart of The Sea are still unobtainable without additional mods or datapacks.

If (like me) you can live without Cocoa Beans but still want to be able to use Conduits to take on Ocean Monuments, I recommend using my [Balanced Craftable Heart of the Sea](https://modrinth.com/datapack/balanced-craftable-heart-of-the-sea) datapack with this world type.
